answer_1.quote: In this work, we propose HERMES, the first approach to generate formulas through hierarchical Formulet expansion.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the following metrics: (1) Sketch accuracy, (2) Sketch-with-value accuracy, (3) Cell reference accuracy, and (4) Formula accuracy, which measures the percentage of correctly predicted formula sketch, sketch-with-value, all cell references in the formula, and the entire formula.
